hook.text: Nvidia董事会恢复黄仁勋CEO职务
弗吉尼亚和俄勒冈起诉SpaceX，指向Grok

summary.sub: 一条人事、一条收购、一条诉讼。每条都对过一手原文和独立媒体，原文没写的地方文中直接说明。

items.t: Nvidia董事会恢复黄仁勋总裁、CEO和董事职务，距他11月12日辞职11天；公司另设首席合规官岗位
Amazon签约收购以色列公司Decart的推理优化技术DOS和创始团队，用于优化推理和自研芯片性能
弗吉尼亚和俄勒冈总检察长分别起诉SpaceX，称Grok生成包括儿童在内的性化图像，安全宣传误导

title.text: Nvidia董事会恢复黄仁勋CEO职务

oneline.text: 辞职11天后回归，董事会称收到美国政府高层意见。

bullets.v: 董事会恢复黄仁勋总裁、CEO和董事职务，并称其回归不构成国家安全风险。
独立董事委员会的调查继续，Nvidia还要新设首席合规官，事情没有结束。
做GPU采购和云资源规划的团队，短期看供货和路线图，不必因为人事反复改计划。

sourceEvidence.claim: 黄仁勋恢复总裁、CEO和董事职务
sourceEvidence.quote: Jensen Huang has been reinstated as President and Chief Executive Officer and as a member of the Board.
NVIDIA is commencing a search to fill a new position, Chief Compliance Officer

sourceEvidence.claim: 董事会一致决定恢复其职务
sourceEvidence.quote: the board had unanimously reinstated him as president, CEO, and a director
Nvidia announced Huang's resignation on Nov. 12.

oneline.text: 买的是DOS技术和创始团队，目标是让模型在自研芯片上跑得更省。

bullets.v: Amazon签约收购Decart Optimization Stack背后的专有技术和创始团队，尚需监管审批。
TechCrunch称Amazon准备把Trainium芯片卖给客户，与Nvidia竞争，推理优化是关键一环。
在AWS上跑推理的团队，接下来值得对比Trainium和GPU实例的单位token成本。

sourceEvidence.quote: Amazon announced it has signed an agreement to purchase the proprietary technology behind the Decart Optimization Stack (DOS)
Completion of the transaction is subject to customary closing conditions, including regulatory clearance.
Amazon will acquire the technology behind DOS, as well as Decart’s founding team
is preparing to start selling them to customers as a competitor to Nvidia.

title.text: 两州起诉SpaceX，指Grok生成性化图像

oneline.text: 弗吉尼亚和俄勒冈是最早因Grok起诉SpaceX的州。

bullets.v: 两州总检察长分别在里士满和Multnomah县法院起诉，称Grok生成包括儿童在内的性化图像。
诉状还指SpaceX把Grok图像生成宣传为总体安全，属误导宣传。
做图像生成产品的团队，安全宣传要和实际拦截能力对得上，否则就是法律风险。

sourceEvidence.claim: 指控未能阻止Grok生成性化图像
sourceEvidence.quote: failed to prevent Grok from generating sexualized images of people, including children
Attorney General Jones’ lawsuit was filed in the Circuit Court for the City of Richmond.
Virginia and Oregon are the first states to sue Elon Musk's SpaceX
Both Virginia and Oregon are seeking injunctions, civil penalties, disgorgement and legal costs
